title: About the Author
text: About the Author MARTHA WELLS has written many fantasy novels, including The Wizard Hunters, Wheel of the Infinite, the Books of the Raksura series (beginning with The Cloud Roads ), and the Nebula-nominated The Death of the Necromancer, as well as YA fantasy novels, short stories, and nonfiction. She has had stories in Black Gate, Realms of Fantasy, Stargate Magazine, Lightspeed Magazine, and in the anthologies Elemental, Tales of the Emerald Serpent, The Other Half of the Sky, The Gods of H. P . Lovecraft, and M ECH : Age of Steel . She has also written media tie-ins for Stargate: Atlantis and most recently Star Wars: Razor’s Edge . The last book in the Books of the Raksura series, The Harbors of the Sun, was released in July 2017. You can sign up for email updates here .
